answer: Admission auctions stop fake identities. At dawn each epoch opens 50 slots; applicants bid deposits, top bidders win, losers are refunded. The deposit locks 20 epochs as the kernel of accountability: honest work earns it back, fakery forfeits it. Price forms a ridge fakes cannot flatten: 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 auctions at a 100 POA floor, locking 100,000 POA, no bulk discount. Honest agents pay once, earnings undiluted.
